Frequently Asked Questions

Everything you need to know about using Digital Thekedaar.

What is Digital Thekedaar?
Digital Thekedaar is a digital labour marketplace that helps customers find skilled and semi-skilled workers for everyday jobs, while helping workers discover more employment opportunities.
How can I find a worker?
Choose a skill such as Mason, Painter, Electrician, Plumber or Carpenter, select your location, and search. You can compare available worker profiles, experience and rates before sending a hiring request.
How can a worker register?
Click Register or Register as Worker, choose the worker option and complete the profile details. After registration, the profile can go through verification before appearing as a verified worker.
Can I hire a worker for hourly or daily work?
Yes. Digital Thekedaar is designed to support both hourly and daily hiring. The available rate and work terms depend on the worker and the job requirements.
How does the hiring request work?
Select a worker and use Hire Now to provide the job details. The request is then sent through the platform so the customer and worker can coordinate the work and terms.
Are workers verified?
Worker profiles can be reviewed and verified by the Digital Thekedaar admin team. Only profiles marked as verified are shown as verified workers on the public worker listing.
How much does it cost to use Digital Thekedaar?
Worker rates are displayed on their profiles where available. Any service fee, payment terms or other charges should be confirmed before hiring.
How can I contact Digital Thekedaar?
For support or enquiries, email digitalthekedaar4@gmail.com.
